verses.77:4: And ˹by˺ those ˹angels˺ fully distinguishing ˹truth from falsehood˺
verses.77:7: Surely, what you are promised will come to pass
verses.77:8: So when the stars are put out
verses.77:9: and the sky is torn apart
verses.77:10: and the mountains are blown away
verses.77:11: and the messengers’ time ˹to testify˺ comes up—
verses.77:12: for which Day has all this been set
verses.77:14: And what will make you realize what the Day of Decision is
verses.77:15: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.77:16: Did We not destroy earlier disbelievers
verses.77:17: And We will make the later disbelievers follow them
verses.77:18: This is how We deal with the wicked
verses.77:19: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.77:20: Did We not create you from a humble fluid
verses.77:21: placing it in a secure place
verses.77:23: We ˹perfectly˺ ordained ˹its development˺. How excellent are We in doing so
verses.77:24: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.77:25: Have We not made the earth a lodging
verses.77:26: for the living and the dead
verses.77:27: and placed upon it towering, firm mountains, and given you fresh water to drink
verses.77:28: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.77:29: ˹The disbelievers will be told,˺ “Proceed into that ˹Fire˺ which you used to deny
verses.77:30: Proceed into the shade ˹of smoke˺ which rises in three columns
verses.77:31: providing neither coolness nor shelter from the flames
verses.77:32: Indeed, it hurls sparks ˹as big˺ as huge castles
verses.77:34: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.77:35: On that Day they will not ˹be in a position to˺ speak
verses.77:36: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses
verses.77:37: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.77:38: ˹They will be told by Allah,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision: We have gathered you along with earlier disbelievers ˹for punishment˺
verses.77:39: So if you have a scheme ˹to save yourselves˺, then use it against Me.”
verses.77:40: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.77:41: Indeed, the righteous will be amid ˹cool˺ shade and springs
verses.77:43: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”
verses.77:44: Surely this is how We reward the good-doers
verses.77:45: ˹But˺ woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.77:46: “Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while, ˹for˺ you are truly wicked.”
verses.77:47: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.77:48: When it is said to them, “Bow down ˹before Allah,” they do not bow
verses.77:49: Woe on that Day to the deniers
verses.77:50: So what message after this ˹Quran˺ would they believe in
